pages.text: $(italic)Aggressive, hungry, and hits like a falling anvil. Orcs excel in sustained melee at the cost of resource drain.$()$(br2)$(bold)Racial Traits:$()$(br2)$(bold)Ferocity$() — +12% attack speed. Pairs extremely well with Berserker's Blood Fury.$(br2)$(bold)Knockback Mastery$() — +30% knockback dealt. Enemies you hit stagger further. Useful for crowd control.$(br2)$(bold)Hunger Drain$() — +35% food drain rate. The highest penalty in the pack. Always eat before fights.$(br2)$(bold)Brutish$() — Immunity to Weakness potion effect. Resistance to Slowness is halved in duration.
